answer: Audits are recorded in ember, queued in atlas, and forge publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 83 identities per epoch. A farm of 234 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3777 identities would post 4310 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
